title: Smith 2004 canonical CellML variable and equation dictionary
status: evidence review draft 2026-11-01; equations transcribed mechanically from MathML; interpretation fields are ours and marked; nothing here changes the model

equations.infix: (tau = piecewise{ time if time<=period ; time-period if time<=2*period ; ... ; time-12*period if time<=13*period })  [14-beat explicit remainder, see CellML]

(d(V_lv)/dtime = piecewise{ 0[mL_per_second] if ((Q_mt < 0[mL_per_second]) and (Q_av < 0[mL_per_second])) ; (-Q_av) if (Q_mt < 0[mL_per_second]) ; Q_mt if (Q_av < 0[mL_per_second]) ; (Q_mt - Q_av) otherwise })

(d(V_rv)/dtime = piecewise{ 0[mL_per_second] if ((Q_tc < 0[mL_per_second]) and (Q_pv < 0[mL_per_second])) ; (-Q_pv) if (Q_tc < 0[mL_per_second]) ; Q_tc if (Q_pv < 0[mL_per_second]) ; (Q_tc - Q_pv) otherwise })

(0[kPa] = (((((e_t * E_es_spt * (V_spt - V_d_spt)) + ((one - e_t) * P_0_spt * (exp((lambda_spt * (V_spt - V_0_spt))) - one))) - (e_t * E_es_lvf * (V_lv - V_spt))) - ((1[dimensionless] - e_t) * P_0_lvf * (exp((lambda_lvf * (V_lv - V_spt))) - 1[dimensionless]))) + (e_t * E_es_rvf * (V_rv + V_spt)) + ((1[dimensionless] - e_t) * P_0_rvf * (exp((lambda_rvf * (V_rv + V_spt))) - 1[dimensionless]))))
(d(Q_mt)/dtime = piecewise{ 0[mL_per_second2] if (((P_pu - P_lv) < 0[kPa]) and (Q_mt < 0[mL_per_second])) ; (((P_pu - P_lv) - (Q_mt * R_mt)) / L_mt) otherwise })
(d(Q_av)/dtime = piecewise{ 0[mL_per_second2] if (((P_lv - P_ao) < 0[kPa]) and (Q_av < 0[mL_per_second])) ; (((P_lv - P_ao) - (Q_av * R_av)) / L_av) otherwise })
(d(Q_tc)/dtime = piecewise{ 0[mL_per_second2] if (((P_vc - P_rv) < 0[kPa]) and (Q_tc < 0[mL_per_second])) ; (((P_vc - P_rv) - (Q_tc * R_tc)) / L_tc) otherwise })
(d(Q_pv)/dtime = piecewise{ 0[mL_per_second2] if (((P_rv - P_pa) < 0[kPa]) and (Q_pv < 0[mL_per_second])) ; (((P_rv - P_pa) - (Q_pv * R_pv)) / L_pv) otherwise })

open_items: C1 decided 2026-11-01: CellML numerals read as mmHg-based, no conversion; R13 lifted (decisions.md)
C2 resolved: V_tot is an unused, mislabelled total blood volume; the simulated stressed volume is the 1500 mL sum of initial volumes
C3 peripheral P_th terms (E19, E21; Revie also on P_vc) are not in the manuscript; source UNKNOWN
C7 period 0.75 s confirmed (80 bpm); closed-loop delay C = 0.375 s has no located source
C9 L_mt, L_tc (E29, E31) not in the manuscript, which has inertia only at aortic and pulmonary outflow
C10 E18 omits V_d/V_0 offsets present in manuscript Eq. 20 (no effect at current zero values)
C11 valve law: manuscript removes Q from the state vector; CellML holds dQ/dt = 0, so a negative Q is frozen (matches Hermes run C)
V_spt implicit equation E18 solved by NLA; V_spt initial value absent
Driver function E1 covers only 13 periods explicitly (14 beats per PMR note)
SemSim ws267 annotates V_lvf/V_rvf/V_spt with OPB_01061 (van't Hoff law), a dependency class, not a property: reference-annotation defect
SemSim ws267 free text for P_peri reads "Pericardial blood volume" while the property is Fluid pressure of Portion of pericardial fluid: text/annotation conflict
SemSim ws267 free text for Q_av/R_av/L_av says "atrial valve" while the process is named "Blood flow through aortic valve": naming defect
C3 P_vc thoracic-pressure term: CellML E25 has none; Revie 2013 (A.3) includes +P_th on P_vc (and on P_pu, P_pa, not P_ao)
